stories.title: Typo in footer copyright year
stories.description: The footer of the customer portal still shows © 2025.
stories.steps:
1. Open any page of the portal
2. Scroll to the footer
stories.rationale: Static text change in one file, no logic, security or data impact.
stories.criteria:
- Footer shows the current year
- Unit test covers the year helper

stories.title: Sort quote history newest first
stories.description: Customers have to scroll to find their latest quote. The quote history should show the newest quote on top.
stories.rationale: Change of a single sort order in the quote list component.
stories.criteria:
- Quote history is sorted by date, newest first
- Test checks the sort order

stories.title: New logo in portal header
stories.description: Marketing delivered the new PowerStudios logo. Replace the header logo on all pages.
stories.rationale: Change requests are not in scope for autonomous delivery and brand approval is needed.
stories.criteria:
- New logo on all pages
- Logo has alt text
- Approved by Marketing

stories.title: Postal code field rejects codes with spaces
stories.description: Customers who type '3500 ' with a trailing space get 'invalid postal code'.
stories.steps:
1. Open Quote calculator
2. Type '3500 ' as postal code
stories.rationale: Trim of one input value in the validation function.
stories.criteria:
- Leading and trailing spaces are ignored
- Test covers '3500 ' and ' 3500'

stories.title: Change support phone number in footer
stories.description: The support line moves to 011 23 45 67 on the first of next month.
stories.rationale: Change requests are routed to a human by policy, even when simple.
stories.criteria:
- Footer shows 011 23 45 67
- Change goes live in the agreed release

stories.title: Show quote reference on confirmation screen
stories.description: When customers call us about a quote they cannot find the reference. Show it on the confirmation screen.
stories.rationale: Additive UI change in one component; the reference already exists in the quote object.
stories.criteria:
- Confirmation screen shows 'Quote reference Q-xxxx'
- Test checks the reference is visible

stories.title: Multi-currency quotes
stories.description: Our Dutch partner wants quotes in EUR and their German customers want CHF as an option.
stories.rationale: Touches the calculation model, rounding rules and formatting across pages.
stories.criteria:
- Currency selectable on the calculator
- Totals rounded per currency
- Existing EUR quotes unchanged

stories.title: Rounding error in monthly instalment
stories.description: The monthly instalment for 12 months is shown as €400.0000001.
stories.steps:
1. Quote calculator
2. Home battery x1, 12 instalments
stories.rationale: Formatting of one value in one function; no change to the calculation itself.
stories.criteria:
- Instalments are rounded to 2 decimals
- Unit test for 12 and 24 instalments

stories.title: Can customers download older quotes?
stories.description: A customer asks whether quotes older than one year can still be downloaded.
stories.rationale: Question, no change needed. Answered by the Intake Agent: quotes stay available for 3 years.

stories.title: Session cookie not marked Secure
stories.description: Security scan reports that the session cookie has no Secure flag.
stories.rationale: Authentication and security impact: risk High, always routed to a human.
stories.criteria:
- Session cookie has Secure and SameSite flags
- Security scan passes

stories.title: Clearer error when quote amount is empty
stories.description: When quantity is empty the calculator shows 'NaN'. Show 'Enter a quantity' instead.
stories.rationale: Message text and one guard clause in the calculator page.
stories.criteria:
- Empty quantity shows 'Enter a quantity'
- No 'NaN' visible
- Test covers the empty case

stories.title: Data export misses quotes of the last day
stories.description: The monthly CSV export to finance never includes quotes created on the last day of the month.
stories.expected: Expected: quotes of 31 October included. Actual: missing.
stories.rationale: Date boundary logic in the export integration, time zone dependent; low confidence.
stories.criteria:
- Export includes the full last day in Europe/Brussels time
- Regression test for month ends

stories.title: Upgrade Vite to the latest major version
stories.description: Vite is two major versions behind. Upgrade and fix breaking changes.
stories.rationale: Technical debt is not in the autonomous scope and the upgrade touches build and deploy.
stories.criteria:
- Build and tests green on the new version
- Deploy workflow unchanged

stories.title: Remove unused legacy discount helper
stories.description: legacyDiscount() is no longer called anywhere.
stories.rationale: Simple and low risk, but technical debt is not in the autonomous scope.
stories.criteria:
- Function removed
- All tests green

stories.title: Rename 'Policy' to 'Contract' across the portal
stories.description: Legal wants the word 'Contract' instead of 'Policy' on every page and e-mail.
stories.rationale: Many files and texts affected, needs review by Legal.
stories.criteria:
- No 'Policy' left in the UI
- Legal approved the texts

stories.title: How is the no-claim discount calculated?
stories.description: Customer service asks how the 5% loyalty discount is applied.
stories.rationale: Question, no change needed. Answered by the Intake Agent.

stories.title: Broken link to terms and conditions
stories.description: The 'Terms and conditions' link on the quote page returns a 404.
stories.rationale: One link target in one page.
stories.criteria:
- Link opens the terms page
- Smoke test checks the link

stories.title: Remember last used product in calculator
stories.description: Returning customers want the calculator to preselect the product they used last time.
stories.rationale: Local storage of one value in the calculator page, no personal data.
stories.criteria:
- Last product is preselected on return
- Test covers first visit and return visit

stories.title: Quote print shows wrong customer name
stories.description: The printed quote shows the name of the previous customer on a shared PC.
stories.steps:
1. Create a quote as customer A
2. Log out, create one as customer B
3. Print
stories.expected: Expected: customer B. Actual: customer A.
stories.rationale: Stale value in one render function; no data model change.
stories.criteria:
- Printed quote always shows the current customer
- Test covers the switch

stories.title: Add 'Copy quote number' button
stories.description: Customer service wants a button to copy the quote number so customers can paste it in e-mails.
stories.rationale: Additive button in one component using the clipboard API.
stories.criteria:
- Button copies the quote number
- Confirmation 'Copied' shown
- Test checks the button

stories.title: Faster loading of quote history
stories.description: Quote history takes 6 seconds for customers with more than 50 quotes.
stories.rationale: Needs paging in the data layer and API changes; complexity Complex.
stories.criteria:
- History loads within 1 second for 200 quotes
- Paging of 20 items

stories.title: Wrong date format on invoice page
stories.description: The invoice page shows dates as 11/03/2026 (US format). Belgian customers read this as 11 March instead of 3 November.
stories.steps:
1. Log in to the portal
2. Open an invoice
stories.rationale: Formatting change in one helper (formatDate) used by the invoice page; no data, calculation or security impact. Confidence 93%.
stories.criteria:
- Invoice dates use the format '3 Nov 2026'
- formatDate has a unit test for a date in November
- No other page changes

stories.title: Password reset mail not received
stories.description: Several customers report that the password reset e-mail never arrives.
stories.expected: Expected: mail within 1 minute. Actual: no mail.
stories.rationale: Authentication flow and external mail service involved: risk High.
stories.criteria:
- Reset mail arrives within 1 minute
- Failure is logged and alerted

stories.title: Sign in with itsme
stories.description: Customers want to sign in with itsme instead of a password.
stories.rationale: New authentication method with an external identity provider: risk High and complex.
stories.criteria:
- itsme sign-in available on the login page
- Existing password login keeps working

stories.title: Show tooltip on discount field
stories.description: Customers don't understand the discount field. Add a tooltip 'Loyalty discount for existing customers'.
stories.rationale: Additive tooltip text on one field.
stories.criteria:
- Tooltip visible on hover and focus
- Accessible via keyboard
